name: BGE Reranker Large
attention_variant: cross-encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full bidirectional attention over query+passage
notes: RERANKER: cross-encoder, kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 0, KV formula does not apply. XLM-RoBERTa-large backbone (hidden 1024, 24 layers, 16 heads, vocab 250002, 514 max_position_embeddings). N passages = N independent forward passes over (query+passage) pairs with no KV reuse. Cost scales linearly with number of passages. The 514-token limit is the binding constraint — long passages must be truncated before reranking. MIT license. GGUF and ONNX ports exist.
